tagline: Animated themes, painted into your real taskbar
brief: Windows 11 OLED-safe taskbar themes. Local, MIT, dark-first. Logo should read as display + motion + phosphor light (phos / φως), not a generic P-tile.
criteria: Works as tray + favicon, ember under wavy edge (not inside screen), corona reads as light not protection badge.

concepts.name: Corona Tide
concepts.idea: A solid screen with a phosphor corona; ember closes the parallelogram under the wavy tide edge.
rationale: Phos / φως as fading corona — light without a shield cliché
Wavy bottom = motion in the taskbar; ember stays below the wave
Small-size cut keeps core + one ring for tray and favicon

recommendation: Corona Tide (final). Ship colour master + small cut + mono silhouette; retire the orange P-tile.
next_steps: Drop web/ icons into site/public and assets/brand
Outline wordmark for print if needed
